fact: ANSI, the national information society agency, designed SIGEPAP-GNN, the personnel, postings and pensions system of the National Guard, presented on 23 April 2025 under an ANSI-National Guard memorandum of August 2024.
ANSI's technical teams designed and developed SIGEPAP-GNN, which was presented and handed to the National Guard on 23 April 2025 and is described as deployed.
